WITH project_rates AS (
  SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux,
         AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS size_per_minute
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL
    AND s.spanmin <> 0
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(size_per_minute) AS avg_project_rate
  FROM project_rates
)
SELECT pr.arcref AS project_reference,
       pr.fundflux AS funding_source,
       pr.size_per_minute AS rate,
       pr.size_per_minute - b.avg_project_rate AS gap_above_benchmark
FROM project_rates AS pr
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE pr.size_per_minute > b.avg_project_rate
ORDER BY gap_above_benchmark DESC
LIMIT 10;
